name: Adam Dunn
caption: Billed out of Cape Town, South Africa and half-brother to Chris Dunn on the same roster, he was one of four wrestlers OWA carried over from World Elite Wrestling's own developmental brand.

name: Alex Madsen
caption: A six-foot-five Long Islander whose own bio runs him through Ring of Honor tryouts and an XWA Intercontinental reign before OWA, and who opened the Rage in the Cage card against Luke Bane.

name: Alyssa Davies
caption: Signed to OWA as a wrestler and valet, trained five years by Sara Del Rey after finishing a business degree she took as a fallback.

name: Angelita Henderson
caption: Worked her way from hairstylist to make-up artist to manager to wrestler across two federations, and won the OWA Women's Championship contendership in the first Anarchy of the fed's 2017 return.

name: Brett Edgar
caption: One half of Made in Detroit with the schoolfriend he learned the business beside, and half of the first OWA Tag Team Championship team, won in a triple-threat tornado cage match on the Rage in the Cage kickoff.

name: Brooklyn Chandler
caption: Retired out of World Elite Wrestling after a knee injury and a pregnancy, then billed again by OWA, where she opened Rage in the Cage against Clarissa Evans.

name: Ella Dunn
caption: A Columbia linguistics graduate who had meant to work for the United Nations, billed by OWA as a wrestler, valet and model out of London and New York.

name: Ethan Williams
caption: Wrestled school gyms across Europe for twenty or thirty people, trained a little with William Regal on the psychology of it, then debuted for OWA on the 23 February 2017 Anarchy as Hunter Gage's chosen opponent.

name: Erin Spencer-Wolfe
caption: Won the OWA Women's Championship in a six-pack challenge at the live event that restarted the federation in January 2017, and defended it inside a steel cage six weeks later.

name: Kylie Connelly
caption: Learned the business in San Juan under Carlos Colón Sr. as Kylita before four years in Puerto Rico gave way to an American run and an OWA contract.

name: Mariella Riley
caption: A Roman bodybuilder and model who general-managed Anarchy alongside her husband from March 2016, and was billed on OWA's own staff list as its seamstress.

name: Mason Wolfe
caption: Founded the Orlando Wrestling Alliance, ran it as owner and president, and booked himself the inaugural OWA Intercontinental Championship out of a fatal five-way in January 2017.

identity.note: A character of the same name was billed in WWE The E-Fed, a retired alternate-history portrayal (see the referent test) whose own wiki shared an editor account with this one; the two records never cited each other and no document named both. Filed distinct pending evidence, per the collision doctrine — when in doubt we do not merge.

name: Olivia Rhodes
caption: A former gymnast, cheerleader and volleyball player who signed her first wrestling contract in November 2016 and her OWA one months later.

name: Rebekah Dunn
caption: Born to missionaries in Cape Town and got into wrestling through the schoolfriend she later married, billed by OWA as a wrestler and valet.

name: Ruby Chambers
caption: Signed to OWA in February 2017 out of a training path that ran from Sara Del Rey to Al Snow, billed as “Winter's Poison” and “Miss Misery.”

name: Ryan Henderson
caption: A third-generation wrestler by his own bio's account, whose grandfather and father both worked before him and whose OWA run came after a long stretch in the Xtreme Wrestling Organization.

name: Sabine
caption: An Athens-born singer who won talent contests through school and passed on a singing career for wrestling, signing with OWA on 18 February 2017.

name: Sansa
caption: An Upper East Side upbringing she walked away from the day after graduation, and a former WEW Women's Champion by the time OWA billed her into the Rage in the Cage contendership cage match.

name: Shane Miller
caption: The other half of Made in Detroit, and half of the first OWA Tag Team Championship team; he and Brett Edgar went to the same high school and learned the business together.

name: Siobhán O'Keeffe
caption: Trained by Dave Finlay from the year she left Trinity College Dublin, and moved from Dublin to Orlando in January 2017 when OWA signed her.

name: Tyler Chandler
caption: Won an open battle royal on the first night OWA ever ran to become its inaugural Heavyweight Champion, and was still champion at 327 days when the record stops.
